Subject: Request for Confirmation

Dear [Client's Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

We have sent you the document that contains all the information regarding the agreement. Please review the document and confirm your acceptance of the terms.

Kindly send an email to contact@contact.com with the subject "confirmation" to let us know if you have reviewed the document and agree to the terms.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]
